records.name: Finland
records.summary_text: Finland is very safe for trans visitors. There are no documented severe trans-specific incidents (no tourist-rape, mob-violence or police-brutality case); bathrooms are unrestricted, there is no criminalisation, and the Schengen border poses no trans-specific friction. Record-level hate-crime reporting exists, but no incident series involving trans visitors is documented.
